decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The revised proposal for a service corridor to the north of the proposed large food store shown on Plan number A916/PL005 would not harm the appearance of the area, adversely effect the use of any adjoining land, parking and servicing provision within the site or local highway safety and would not harm any interests of acknowledged importance in accordance with UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 T.1.4. T.4.4.and T.4.6.

Condition : 2 - Informative:

This decision refers only and explicitly to the proposed service corridor to the proposed Asda food store.  It does not imply any permission for any other details shown on Plan number A916/PL005 (revision O) which are not shown on the previously approved plans for this development, nor for any changes to the approved external materials.
description: Variaton of Condition 4 (in accordance with plans) of planning permission 00616/F/P5 to construct a corridor to rear of foodstore.
